reviewContext.note: Fresh-context adversary review, zero prior conversational context. Per the manifest's explicit instruction, iteration 3's 6 claimed fixes (FIND-201..206) were NOT accepted at face value -- every real cited source file was re-read fresh: /Users/anicca/anicca/skills/self/spawn/lib/ledger.js, /Users/anicca/anicca/skills/self/spawn/lib/child-spec.js (+ __tests__/child-spec.test.js), /Users/anicca/anicca/skills/self/spawn/run.sh, /Users/anicca/anicca/install.sh, /Users/anicca/anicca/identity/genesis.md, /Users/anicca/anicca/skills/economy/ubi/run.sh, plus /Users/anicca/anicca/skills/_shared/lib/is-self-funded.mjs, /Users/anicca/anicca/skills/economy/gig/lib/lock.mjs, /Users/anicca/anicca/skills/earn/lib/resolve-identity.mjs, /Users/anicca/anicca/skills/self/spawn/lib/spawn-decision.js, /Users/anicca/anicca/skills/economy/gig/lib/ensure-agent-id.mjs, /Users/anicca/anicca/skills/self/telemetry-collect.sh, and /Users/anicca/anicca/skills/self/spawn/scripts/akt-treasury.sh for the broader fresh pass. All 6 of iteration 3's findings (FIND-201..206) ARE confirmed genuinely resolved AS STATED against the real, current on-disk source: (a) run.sh:136 literally reads '"${ANICCA_GENERATION:-1}"', confirming REQ-206's generation=1 default claim; (b) install.sh:77-94 literally copies REPO_ROOT/identity/genesis.md verbatim into ANICCA_HOME when present (only falling back to a DIFFERENT literal heredoc text if that repo file is absent), and identity/genesis.md is confirmed a real, existing, hashable canonical file, grounding REQ-206's constitutionHash claim; (c) economy/ubi/run.sh:68 literally defines RESERVE = 5.0 and its bal() helper literally falls back to balance_native.usdc (line 76-79), grounding REQ-101's reuse claim exactly; (d) REQ-402's promised children_bootstrap_failed feed into REQ-102 is genuinely removed with an explicit, structurally-checkable non-effect (PROP-402d); (e) REQ-101's vestigial claude-p directory-listing edge case is genuinely deleted; (f) REQ-206's 'at least one, not XOR' EARS rewrite remains internally consistent. HOWEVER, a deeper, mechanism-level (not merely location/contradiction-level) fresh pass over the SAME areas these 6 fixes touch, plus the rest of both documents, surfaces 5 NEW defects, three of them critical, that were not caught by iteration 3's review: (1) FIND-201's fix (the new filterProductiveCitizens join against ledger.js rows) assumes ledger.js supports updating/keying an existing row by child_id, but the real, cited ledger.js (confirmed unmodified per the spec's own Purity Boundary claim) only supports raw JSONL append with zero update/dedup capability, and the pre-existing run.sh demonstrably produces MULTIPLE rows per child_id in real usage -- the spec never specifies how filterProductiveCitizens reconciles duplicate child_id matches, the exact gap the iteration-4 manifest asked to be checked. (2) FIND-202/205's fix (telemetryPath as an already-resolved absolute local path) works for today's 2 co-located citizens but is structurally unreachable for any actual spawned child, which REQ-301 mandates must run exclusively on a remote cloud lease -- no mechanism is specified for a cloud-hosted child's telemetry to ever reach the coordinator's local disk, and the one real precedent in this codebase (telemetry-collect.sh) only ever operates for co-located instances. (3) The SAME root gap independently breaks REQ-403's live wallet audit: resolve-identity.mjs's real source is confirmed to be a pure local fs.readFileSync-based resolver, unusable by the coordinator against a remotely-hosted child's own wallet files, making PROP-403b's 'including an actual spawned child' requirement unimplementable as specified. Two further, lower-severity-but-still-major findings round out the pass: a 'wallet' field-name collision across three incompatible shapes (child-spec.js's row: address string; citizens.json: boolean flags; walletAddress: address strings) that the spec's own FIND-104 precedent should have prevented but does not address here; and REQ-306's claim to reuse 'already-available' AKT/USD and NOS/SOL/USD price-conversion mechanisms, which a full read of akt-treasury.sh and a repo-wide grep confirm do not actually exist anywhere in this codebase.
